description: Crop, resize, convert and compress one local image. Keep the full original when size/crop are omitted. Percent crop coordinates refer to the EXIF-oriented original; fitting happens after extraction. Exact max_bytes includes metadata. Default conflict_policy=error never silently reduces requested dimensions. JPEG transparency/letterboxing requires an explicit background. Save a NEW local file and return its actual dimensions, bytes and file resource. No image uploads or external service calls.

background.description: Explicit opaque background for JPEG transparency or letterboxing.

conflict_policy.description: error preserves requested dimensions; shrink permits proportional downscaling to meet max_bytes.

crop.description: Percentages (0–100) of the EXIF-oriented original; extraction happens before fitting.

max_bytes.description: Maximum actual output bytes including density metadata; 1 KB = 1000 bytes.

size.description: Omit to keep original/cropped dimensions. One dimension derives the other proportionally. Inch values are multiplied by PPI and rounded.

path.description: Local image path, absolute or relative to the MCP process working directory. Not a URL or client attachment ID.

name: prepare_image
title: Prepare image
